question: Does changing only the number of equal-notional slots raise terminal wealth while preserving the development-selected scale-out exit's win rate, payoff and drawdown?
single_variable: Shared account capacity [1,3,6,9,12,18,24] unlevered equal positions. Original CRC same-boundary priority, actual collateral for every accepted trade, only one position per symbol, original scale-out legs. Fewer slots concentrate positions and more slots admit a larger share of simultaneous signals.
selection: Before inspecting new slot-count outcomes: use only the scale-out development pick. Among capacities with >=100 development completions, >=30% net wins, >=2.5 equal-notional net payoff and conservative hourly DD<=35%, select highest development account growth. If none qualify, retain 12 and show the highest-growth capacity descriptively. No selection on 2025/26. This follow-up was motivated by the parent result; its later period has been seen.
